invalid: The published learning limits are unavailable. Contact your course team before starting; no new enrollment will be created here.
window.title: Your learning window
window.days: {days, plural, one {# calendar day from starting this course.} other {# calendar days from starting this course.}}
window.none: No course calendar window is specified.
zone.approval: Times shown in {zone}. Pauses require approval.
zone.continues: Times shown in {zone}. The calendar continues while you are away.
deadline: Course must finish by {date}. This may end the window earlier.
noDeadline: No separate fixed end date is specified.
target: Suggested target: {date}. This is a planning target, not an extension.
access.readOnly: Course default: after the window closes, existing material remains available for review.
access.closes: Access to existing material closes when the learning window ends.
extensions.title: Extension allowance
extensions.enabled: {days, plural, one {# calendar day} other {# calendar days}} total, across up to {grants, plural, one {# extension} other {# extensions}}. Each extension can add at most {perGrant, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
extensions.none: No extension allowance is included by default.
extensions.note: Extensions are optional offers. Nothing is added or spent unless you explicitly accept the terms and the server confirms it.
limits.title: Additional learning limits
limits.note: Chapter-specific limits may also apply. Your saved course and current chapter dates are shown after starting.
attempted: A start request was sent. If it reached the server, the learning window may already be running. Retrying resumes a saved enrollment if one exists.
ready: Choose Start course when you are ready to begin the enrollment and its course window. Reopening an existing enrollment never resets its clock.
